biggest_catch: You must spend $2,000 in eligible purchases during the first 90 days after account opening to earn the 20,000 bonus points; never spend extra solely to chase the bonus. The card has no annual fee, so the net bonus value is the full $200. Limit one bonus offer per customer and/or per account; existing or previous cardholders may not be eligible.
catches: Never spend extra solely to chase the 20,000-point bonus; only use the card for purchases you would make anyway.
The card has no annual fee, so the $200 bonus is not reduced by a fee.
Limit one bonus offer per customer and/or per account; existing or previous MidFirst cardholders may not be eligible for this one-time bonus.
Applying for a credit card can involve a hard inquiry on your credit report.
If you carry a balance, interest (0% intro APR for 12 billing cycles, then 17.49% - 23.49% variable) can erase the bonus; pay in full each month.
Bonus points are applied within 1-2 statement cycles after qualification; the account must be open and not in default.
Cash advances, balance transfers, fees and cash-equivalent transactions do not count toward the $2,000 threshold.
